definition_en: The lowest wholesale price recorded for a commodity on one trading day at the Kalimati Fruits and Vegetable Market, Kathmandu — Nepal's largest wholesale produce market. NPR per kilogram. Only rows the source itself marks 'Kg' are stored; prices published per piece or per dozen are excluded rather than converted, because converting them would need a weight the source does not give. Breakdown key: commodity. Coverage 2013-06-16 to 2022-04-18 — a closed historical series, NOT current prices. Source: Kalimati Fruits and Vegetable Market Development Board, re-published by Open Data Nepal.

The highest wholesale price recorded for a commodity on one trading day at the Kalimati Fruits and Vegetable Market, Kathmandu. NPR per kilogram. Same Kg-only rule, breakdown key and coverage as KALIMATI_PRICE_MIN. The source also publishes an 'Average' column, which is NOT loaded: it is exactly the midpoint of the day's minimum and maximum in 100% of 5,000 rows sampled across the full series, and it differs from the market board's own published average — so it is derived for display and labelled a midpoint, never called an average.

The Kalimati Fruits and Vegetable Market Development Board's OWN published average price for a commodity on one trading day, NPR per kilogram, taken directly from the board rather than from a re-publisher. This is a genuine average and NOT the midpoint of the day's low and high: the board's own daily page shows, for example, a commodity with minimum 30 and maximum 40 carrying an average of 34.85. Breakdown key: commodity. Coverage begins 2013-06-16 and is updated by the board, so unlike KALIMATI_PRICE_MIN and KALIMATI_PRICE_MAX (which end 2022-04-18) this series continues to the present. Source: kalimatimarket.gov.np price-history API.
